validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed as a real project, not GEM-only. MEED, 24 May 2011 ('Bids in for Iraq Zubair field pipeline'), independently documents the exact entity: an estimated $150m EPC tendered by South Oil Company in April 2011 for a 105-km, 18-inch carbon steel gas pipeline carrying up to 100 MMcf/d from a depot at the Zubair field near Basra to the Fao depot, incl. tie-ins at Zubair-1 and Fao depots and a 10-m service road. The sheet's other cited source (ahewar.org aid=757740, Arabic, 2022) DOES name the pipeline — it looked empty at first because the page is cp1256-encoded; decoded, its Zubair-field section describes the same 18-inch, 100-MMcf/d gas line from a Zubair-field depot to the Fao depot (no length given). However, its wording is a near-verbatim translation of the same tender description, so it is derivative, not independent — effective corroboration is single-origin (tier medium). The third cited ref (bncnetwork.net Zubair-Oil-Field-Fao-Pipeline) returns 200 but is a JS login shell containing NO project data (verifier: values 100/105/18 not found) — it should be replaced everywhere it is used (Fuel/Capacity/Length/Diameter refs). CLASSIFICATION: gas is correct (explicitly a gas pipeline in the tender; the BNC slug's 'Zubair Oil Field' refers to the field, not the commodity); transmission is defensible for a 105-km depot-to-depot trunk. DUPLICATE: no other roster PID covers Zubair->Faw gas (P7436/P7437 Artawi GMP and P7459 Faiha-N.Rumaila are different routes); the historic Zubair->Fao 12/16-inch line (Wikipedia, Az Zubair Field) was a 1950s CRUDE line, not this project. GulfPub's gas map shows no Zubair-Faw gas line — consistent with never built. ATTRIBUTION caveats: (1) EndState/Province 'Al-Faw Peninsula' is not a governorate — Al-Faw is a district of Basrah; should be 'Basrah'. (2) Owner 'Iraq Ministry of Oil [100%]' is a reasonable umbrella but no source states it; MEED names South Oil Company (state upstream operator, since renamed Basra Oil Company) as the tendering entity — no verifiable ref found that literally supports 'Ministry of Oil' as owner, so Owner [ref] left unresolved. SPEC: Length 105 km, Diameter 18 in, Capacity 100 MMcf/d all match MEED exactly (length is MEED-only; ahewar omits it — GEM wiki itself flags length '*include citation'). AWARD (new finding — corrects an earlier 'never awarded' reading): CPECC's 'Major Projects in Iraq' reference list (PDF published 2021-04 at royaldutchshellplc.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Chinas-CPECC-Project-References.pdf), row 37, shows SOC DID award the EPC to China Petroleum Engineering & Construction Corp: contract PRJ-11-4226, 'Engineering, procurement, construction, start up of Gas Pipe Line 18"x0.438 (Zubair/1 - Fao)' — 98 KM carbon steel GR.X per survey plan, Zubair/1 depot to Fao depot plus compressor station, USD 72.35m, FEED+EPCC, 15-Jul-2014 to April 2016. That URL returns 200 but url_verifier cannot token-match compressed PDF text, so it is documented here rather than staged as a ref (standing rule 2 — described, not fabricated). SPEC CONFLICT: the awarded contract says 98 km vs MEED/sheet 105 km, and GEM's own route-derived LengthEstimateKm is 93.11, closer to 98 — see the separate spec validity entry. STATUS: no completion, commissioning or construction-progress evidence ever found after the 2014-2016 execution window (searched EN + AR: 'Zubair Faw gas pipeline', 'انبوب غاز الزبير الفاو', CPECC completion/commissioning, Fao depot gas supply, Iraq Business News, attaqa, zawya); see status review (stale -> cancelled Presumed).

validity.researcher_notes: Material ~7% length disagreement between the two primary independent sources, not silently passed. MEED (2011 tender): 105 km — matches the sheet. CPECC 'Major Projects in Iraq' list (PDF, 2021-04, royaldutchshellplc.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Chinas-CPECC-Project-References.pdf), row 37, contract PRJ-11-4226: '98 KM' carbon steel 18"x0.438 'according to survey plan' from Zubair/1 depot to Fao depot — i.e. the post-survey, as-contracted length, arguably the more authoritative figure. GEM's own LengthEstimateKm (93.11) sides with ~98 rather than 105. Diameter 18 in agrees across MEED + CPECC; capacity 100 MMcf/d appears only in the tender-derived sources (MEED/ahewar). The CPECC PDF cannot pass the token verifier (compressed PDF), so the only stageable length ref remains MEED at 105 — hence concern flagged for human review instead of a value change.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Searched EN + AR for anything newer than the sheet's LastUpdated 2025-07-16: MEED archive, Iraq Business News, zawya, attaqa.net, shafaq, Facebook/SCOP posts, 'الزبير الفاو أنبوب غاز', CPECC completion/commissioning. Corrected evidence timeline: SOC tender with bids in May 2011 (MEED; construction was to take only 10 months); the EPC WAS awarded to CPECC — contract PRJ-11-4226, USD 72.35m FEED+EPCC, 98 km 18-in line Zubair/1 depot -> Fao depot + compressor station, execution window 15-Jul-2014 to April 2016 (CPECC 'Major Projects in Iraq' reference PDF, published 2021-04; URL live but not token-verifiable, so documented not cited) — then total silence: zero completion, commissioning, progress or revival news 2016-2026 in either language. The 2022-05 ahewar listicle merely recycles the 2011 tender description (derivative, not project activity); the undated BNC listing is now an empty login shell (no Wayback copy). GulfPub's professional gas-pipeline map has no Zubair-Faw line — consistent with never completed. The Feb-2026 gas-fired power plant at the Fao depot (Iraq Business News / SCOP) is NOT reported as fed by any Zubair-Faw pipeline — no source connects them. Newest independent evidence: 2021-04 (CPECC list still carrying the contract); newest derivative trace 2022-05; genuine project activity stops with the failed 2014-2016 execution window (~10y dormant). Dormancy rule shelved>=4y -> cancelled applies (sheet's own researcher note concedes nothing since 2022). Proposing cancelled + ShelvedCancelledType=Presumed, CancelledYear=2026 (year of presumption); inference carries NO ref by design (standing rule 2). Note ShelvedYear is blank on the row; if Baird prefers the strict clock-from-shelving reading (GEM only marked it shelved ~2025), keep shelved and back-fill ShelvedYear instead — but the underlying dormancy is a decade past the contracted completion date. CONSOLIDATION (2026-07-28): this is now the SINGLE status ruling for P5857. The cancelled-review leg of the same batch independently reviewed the row and proposed the softer verdict -- retain 'shelved' with ShelvedCancelledType='Presumed' -- reasoning that the newest evidence was the May-2011 MEED tender and that the Libya cancelled-review lesson (absence of news is not evidence of cancellation; Iraqi state tenders of that era routinely went quiet without dying) argued against forcing the ladder. That record is withdrawn because its premise 'no award, no construction' is refuted by the CPECC contract above: the project was contracted and its execution window lapsed a decade ago, and the line is absent from GulfPub's map -- positive evidence of non-completion, not silence. Carried over from that leg, however: NO CancelledYear is staged. An earlier draft of this record proposed CancelledYear=2026, which is the year of review rather than a sourced cancellation date; inventing one would be fabrication (the same refusal the cancelled-review leg applied to P0481). The reviewer therefore gets two edits, Status=cancelled and ShelvedCancelledType=Presumed, with the dissent recorded rather than buried.
